text: Mechanical Design, Electronics Design, Product Development, Validation, GD&T, CAD, FEA
Victaulic Co, a leading manufacturer of construction piping systems.

"Working under Alex Murphy in the Tools Technology group, the intern will work on projects related to the design of electromechanical systems to prototype new products. In addition, the intern will engage with other team members and leaders to gain an understanding of the operations and mission of Victaulic. Several of these projects included analyzing the viability of transitioning current product offerings to cordless power, opening new market segments to the company."

Some examples of work I performed in completing larger projects, including metrology and mechanical design. Most of the projects I was tasked with are potential New Product Development, so they are protected intellectual property and cannot be shared here. All files and images on this page are uploaded with permission.
Some of the Victaulic intern crew after one of our professional development events. I am second from the left in the back row.

Throughout this internship, my main personal goal was to supplement and convert my previous project and academic experience to industry applications. As such, I spent as much time as possible learning about the operations and programs at all parts of the company. I gained valuable experience in a number of industry-standard hardware and software, including SolidWorks, Hexagon, Polyworks, Ansys, Office, Keyence, and more.

I also gained valuable experience through assisting with the Tools group's project management process, focusing on turning stakeholder input into more efficient processes, culminating in a redesigned workflow.
